item: Mailbox STARTTLS helper stops parsing after an accepted upgrade (row 41)
summary: The loopback mail-server helper kept splitting bytes on CRLF after answering STARTTLS/STLS with no TLS context, so a ClientHello whose random bytes held CRLF (about 1 run in 100) got '-ERR unexpected' and the client failed on 'wrong version number' instead of the handshake timeout. It now discards the handshake until the client goes; a refused upgrade stays in plain text. A forced-CRLF test fails before the fix and passes after.
